title: Argentinian Sweet Rhubarb Empanadas with Italian Twist
description: A unique Italian-inspired dessert using sweet Argentinian empanada dough and intensely sweet rhubarb filling.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough and cut into squares.
Mix the rhubarb, sugar, cornstarch, and lemon juice in a separate bowl.
Place a tablespoon of the rhubarb mixture in the center of each dough square.
Brush the edges of the dough with melted butter and fold the dough to form a triangle.
Seal the edges with a fork and place the empanadas on a baking sheet.
Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a drizzle of vanilla extract.
